
### discrete-event simulation 

![](/sim/texfig/discrete-sim-discrete-event-simulation.figure.svg){fig-alt="Queue of events sorted by time and the latest event being pulled from the queue. The event pulled out of the queue is represented by a tuple of a time and an action. Running the action uses and updates a network state. Running the action yields new events, which are added back to the event queue, and outputs like packet traces and counters."}


### action example 1  {.smaller}


* take next packet from send queue for link X
* compute whether packet is lost due to error
* compute when packet is done transmitting 

   * schedule new event to handle next packet in queue at that time

* compute reception time of packet on other end of link 

   * schedule new event to handle packet being received at that time



### action example 2 


* take next packet on link 0 of switch
* compute next link for packet
* add packet to queue for next link
* schedule new events: 

   * to dequeue from next link (if not scheduled already)
